eval: (() => { const ks = []; for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.startsWith('dao-')) ks.push(k); } ks.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)); location.reload(); return 'cleared'; })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; p.setStage(12); document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); ['f1','f2'].forEach(click); document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); p.clear(); const r = [p.place('daotong'), p.place('taomu-jian'), p.place('xiaohulu'), p.place('lihuo-shu')]; const q = p.state.playerQueue; const cds = {}; q.forEach(u => cds[u.cardId] = u.cd); return JSON.stringify({ r, cds }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; const q = p.state.playerQueue; const before = {}; q.forEach(u => before[u.cardId] = u.cd); document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); ['f4','f9'].forEach(click); document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); const after = {}; p.state.playerQueue.forEach(u => after[u.cardId] = u.cd); return JSON.stringify({ before, after, huluOk: after['xiaohulu'] === Math.round(before['xiaohulu']/1.08), spellOk: after['lihuo-shu'] === Math.round(before['lihuo-shu']/1.08), charUnchanged: after['daotong'] === before['daotong'], taomuUnchanged: after['taomu-jian'] === before['taomu-jian'] }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; const q = p.state.playerQueue; const before = {}; q.forEach(u => before[u.cardId] = u.cd); document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); ['b1','b2','b3','b4','b10'].forEach(click); document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); const after = {}; p.state.playerQueue.forEach(u => after[u.cardId] = u.cd); return JSON.stringify({ before, after, charSped: after['daotong'] === Math.round(before['daotong']/1.06), huluUnaffectedByAtkSpeed: after['xiaohulu'] === before['xiaohulu'], spellUnaffectedByAtkSpeed: after['lihuo-shu'] === before['lihuo-shu'], taomuStationUnaffected: after['taomu-jian'] === before['taomu-jian'] }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; const hulu = p.state.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardId==='xiaohulu'); const cdSkill = hulu.cd; p.toggleMode(hulu.uid); const cdHeld = hulu.cd; const lhs = Math.round(cdHeld * 1.06); const rhs = Math.round(cdSkill * 1.08); return JSON.stringify({ mode: hulu.mode, cdStationWithSkillCdr: cdSkill, cdHeldWithAtkSpeed: cdHeld, swapOk: Math.abs(lhs - rhs) <= 2 }); })()
